doc:
Builder Tic Tac rulebook, derived from the lane's speculative physics (fiction-first, NON-CANON).
ALL bodies. ALL sponsors. 2026-2226.

Every rule carries its status (corrected after Sol's review of 0db5da0):
  CANON      Canon II text (sec. numbers)
  LANE       derived in the Weave prototype lane (cited reports)
  LEDGER     derived in builder_cycle_screen (no-free-work requirement)
  RT         RT accepted result used as inspiration (not proof)
  POSTULATE  a minimal new assumption, stated once
Numbers below are computed, not chosen.

postulates.P1: the continuous active hull is the W2/Weave interface (design hypothesis); as a Loom boundary it is part of the R3 new permission
postulates.P2: partner/record frame selection: NOT YET CHOSEN. 0db5da0 conflated two criteria: equal pull (Earth-Sun boundary 259,000 km from Earth; Earth-Moon 38,400 km from the Moon; the Sun pulls the Moon 2.2x harder than Earth, so the Moon region is Sun-frame) versus Laplace sphere of influence (patched-conic perturbation ratio: Earth 924,700 km, Moon 66,200 km)
postulates.P3: the accessible relational range is bounded

rules.rule: R1 The Weave shift moves her without changing her velocity; carries her air; quiet while the field edge is subsonic
rules.status: DERIVED within the adopted field model
rules.basis: slow-geodesic law dw/dt = -(grad b) w is homogeneous (WEAVE_GEOMETRY_COMPARE; continuous_hull_screen B); ideal-fluid transport; edge Mach limit

rules.rule: R2 Directional W2 changes her velocity only while the field travels with her; it pushes her through the air (drag, wake)
rules.status: DERIVED within the adopted field model
rules.basis: potential-type field: lasting velocity when co-moving, returned when fixed (continuous_hull_screen C; lapse dash). Directional use itself is the experimental grant (Sol, after b99d437)

rules.rule: R3 The hull can perform local Loom hops (relocation with a route-transformed arrival state, configuration locked during commit)
rules.basis: canon sec. 12 gives the human Loom (Q_B = T_AB(Q_A), sec. 12.1 commit lock, interstellar role in sec. 18A). A local Builder hop through a 153 m2 hull boundary is a new permission; the area comparison with Wayfarer's ~1,900 m2 does not establish it

rules.rule: R4 Every mode exchanges with an external partner; none is isolated
rules.status: DERIVED within the adopted field model
rules.basis: ADM charges of a compact field vanish; an isolated displacement violates the boost charge (WEAVE_SOURCE_CLOSURE)

rules.rule: R5 A ledger: her relational state records the net ordinary work done on her, linearly (kappa x delta rho), in one record frame
rules.basis: one accounting model that excludes free-work cycles (builder_cycle_screen L1). Not forced: a partner supplying the energy (e.g. the Sun-partner route), a global field state, a nonlinear cost or a finite environmental exchange would also exclude them

rules.rule: R6 Locality: no field operation spans a change of partner frame; she crosses such boundaries by coasting
rules.basis: frame-dependence of work does NOT require the field to stop where the partner changes; this is an adopted restriction. Its boundary depends on the partner criterion, not yet chosen (P2: equal pull and Laplace give different boundaries)

rules.rule: R7 Natural arrival keeps her velocity in the partner frame
rules.basis: canon leaves T_AB unspecified; this arrival rule is a choice, not a consequence of minimum energy

rules.rule: R8 Bounded accessible range; operations refused at the edge
rules.basis: postulate P3 (RT-C1-inspired), conditional on the R5 ledger model. Its size is NOT set: a one-number budget would be an invisible tank (Sol)

rules.rule: R9 Coming home by field restores the record; shedding energy into the world leaves it displaced
rules.basis: true within the R5 ledger model (route dependence, cf. RT-B1); not a general consequence

rules.rule: R10 Route library: a hop needs a surveyed route
rules.basis: motivated by canon sec. 12.1 (certification against a specific configuration) and RT SHG1 (locally identical, globally different); requiring a survey is a design rule

rules.rule: R11 The crew knows what has been spent, not what is left
rules.basis: follows within the R5 ledger plus P3

rules.rule: R12 Wear and stability per hop unknown; humans cannot service the module

numbers.hop_ledger_note: CONDITIONAL EXAMPLES: endpoint change of ordinary mechanical energy under the R5 ledger and the R7 arrival rule; not the cost of forming or controlling a Loom transition, and not local dissipation

open_items: restoration of a spent record (unwind only, or environmental relaxation paid physically): not decided by any theory (builder_cycle_screen)
kappa x rho_max: the one Builder parameter; a kT choice
local heat of each mode: unknown
which body is "force-dominant" near boundaries (Earth-Moon L1 region): P2 needs a tie rule
